'''Darlo''',<ref name="TEA" /> also known as '''Dagobah''',<ref name="EaW">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> was the [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Dagobah system/Legends|Dagobah system]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> The star was [[Color/Legends|yellow]]<ref name="BtMF">{{BuildFalconCite|10|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> and was situated not far from the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" />

Darlo was orbited by five [[Planet/Legends|planets]]: the [[Magma/Legends|molten rock]] world [[Ness]]; the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] planet [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], which was abundant with lifeforms and together with its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]]<ref name="TEA" /> relatively close to Darlo,<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> circling the star once every 341 [[Local day/Legends|local days]]; the terrestrial planet [[Undar]] with its two moons; the [[Water/Legends|icy]] world [[Bubbok]] with its three moons; and the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Sty]] with fifty-five moons.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The star Dagobah was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide]]'', a [[2006]] reference book authored by [[Michael Knight]].<ref name="EaW" /> It was later identified as Darlo by the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-19.<ref name="TEA" />

Darlo was first pictured in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 10|tenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'' magazine,<ref name="BtMF" /> published around [[March 11]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BMFdates|10}}</ref> The image used to depict Darlo was also used in ''Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon'' to illustrate several other stars.<ref name="BMF 31">{{BuildFalconCite|31|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref><ref name="BMF 37">{{BuildFalconCite|37|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref><ref name="BMF 45">{{BuildFalconCite|45|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref><ref name="BMF 52">{{BuildFalconCite|52|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref>
